tokens.leaderRule: Every named point uses one solid two-segment leader; all area names have no point or leader. Length varies with displacement; stroke, opacity and terminal gap are shared. No dashed lines.

limitations: Overview and nine sectors share exactly one continuous surface.
Eight regional maps have separately generated detail refinement; registered companion maps preserve the continuous surface for coordinate comparison.
Local detail plates are separately generated candidates linked by settlement coordinates; not a surveyed continuous land surface.
Source facility anchors are exact, raster buildings may differ; no in-engine traversal or scale validation.
